findings.quote: it happened on Warsh's words rather than on new data
findings.why: The context ties the same Friday repricing to a data surprise as well: JPMorgan reports the core PCE deflator rose 0.25% m/m against a 0.1% consensus and frames it as contributing to the hawkish repricing, which the draft itself concedes in the next bullet.
findings.fix: Drop the 'rather than on new data' contrast, or say the repricing came on Warsh's speech alongside the firmer core PCE print.
